summary: Tavus automates personalized video generation for sales and marketing, using AI face and voice cloning for hyper-personalized outreach at scale.
description:
Tavus automates personalized video generation for sales and marketing, using AI face and voice cloning for hyper-personalized outreach at scale.

Personified Application Layers that see, hear, and respond face-to-face in real time. Build and deploy with our API, no-code PAL Maker, or enterprise Solutions. Interactive AI avatars and conversational video reimagined

Personalized video at scale: Generate thousands of unique, hyper-personalized video messages for every prospect or customer automatically. AI face and voice cloning: Use your likeness and voice to deliver truly authentic and individualized outreach videos. CRM integration: Connect directly with popular CRM tools to personalize videos using live customer data for each message. Analytics dashboard: Measure success with detailed open, view, and engagement tracking for every video sent.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Log In
howToUse.description: Go to Tavus.io and create an account using your work email. Choose a plan that matches your needs and log in to your dashboard.

howToUse.title: Record Your Base Video
howToUse.description: Follow Tavus's guided instructions to record a video template. This base video will be used for AI-driven face and voice cloning, so read the script clearly and use good lighting.

howToUse.title: Set Up Personalization Fields
howToUse.description: Decide which fields (like first name, company, product, etc.) you want to personalize. Map these variables to your contact data or CRM integration.

howToUse.title: Upload Your Audience List or Connect CRM
howToUse.description: Import a CSV of your recipients or connect directly to your CRM (such as HubSpot or Salesforce) for seamless data mapping and automation.

howToUse.title: Generate Personalized Videos
howToUse.description: Tavus's AI engine will process your base video and data fields to create a unique, personalized video for each contact. You can preview a few before generating the full batch.

howToUse.title: Review & Edit
howToUse.description: Check a sample of generated videos for quality, pronunciation, and accuracy. Make adjustments to your template or data and reprocess if needed.

howToUse.title: Send or Share Videos
howToUse.description: Distribute your videos via email, SMS, direct link, or by embedding in landing pages. Tavus supports integrations for automated outreach and campaign tracking.

howToUse.title: Analyze Results
howToUse.description: Monitor open rates, video views, clicks, and conversions in the Tavus analytics dashboard. Use insights to refine future campaigns for better engagement.

howToUse.title: Advanced: API Automation
howToUse.description: For developers or enterprises, use the Tavus API to automate large-scale personalization, trigger video generation from workflows, and retrieve video URLs programmatically.
